question: Which recent Steven C. Bonta lectures and manuscripts match the user's recollection, and what evidence supports his route from fields to proposed readings?
outcome: Identified twelve lectures uploaded 26 October–13 December 2025 and the 2024 second-edition proposal. Recorded field, anchor-value, dictionary-search and ICIT-validation arguments with timestamps. Krishnamurti's chapter summary contradicts the categorical absence of Dravidian noun compounds. No new corpus or chance-matching calculation was run.
challenge: Transcript panel/export unavailable; automatic captions garble terms; extracted manuscript text omits glyphs. Validation object overlap, search tolerance and attempted-reading coverage remain unresolved.
remedy: Read captions loaded by the player; preserve source URLs, exact upload dates, timestamped paraphrases and explicit coverage. Keep first-pass notes separate from the broader program audit prompt and frozen endpoints.
retry_when: A glyph-resolved value table and field rules permit a frozen corpus replication and a lexical-search baseline; ICIT evaluation needs object-level overlap and a complete attempted set. These tests remain proposed.
